technical.summary: Strong bullish structure with golden cross and new highs, but extreme overbought conditions and weak ADX trend strength create pullback risk; suitable for risk-managed entry with tight stops.

fundamental.summary: SRE shows no fundamental momentum with zero insider activity, no institutional signal, absent government contracts, no lobbying presence, and minimal retail interest; earnings in 7 days present elevated volatility risk with no supporting smart money conviction.

sentiment.summary: No current congressional signal; market in fear zone (42 VIX equivalent) with bearish sentiment (40%) presents contrarian opportunity, but stale congressional data (2+ years old) and absent news sentiment limit conviction.

risk.summary: Extreme VIX crisis regime (333), flat yield curve, rising dollar, FOMC event just passed, and critical earnings binary in 7 days create a highly adverse macro and event-driven risk environment for SRE.

debate.key_bull_argument: Golden cross + three white soldiers + DC20 new high provide strong bullish structure with price near support (70.33), offering risk-managed entry with defined stop below support.
debate.key_bear_argument: Extreme overbought conditions (RSI 88/84, Stoch 96), critical earnings binary in 7 days, VIX crisis regime (333), zero fundamental conviction, and price below both 50-SMA and 200-EMA create compounding event and macro risks that outweigh technical setup.

decision.entry_rationale: Technical setup shows golden cross and new highs at support, but this is negated by extreme overbought conditions (RSI 88/84, Stoch 96) and critical earnings binary in 7 days with zero fundamental conviction.
decision.primary_risk: Earnings volatility in 7 days combined with VIX crisis regime (333) and extreme overbought technicals create unacceptable binary risk; no smart money support or insider conviction to justify entry.
decision.agent_agreement: strong — all agents aligned on elevated risk; technical and debate agents acknowledge setup but risk/fundamental agents dominate decision
decision.portfolio_note: Already holding 63 Utilities positions and existing SRE position; sector concentration and earnings proximity warrant avoidance of additional exposure.
